title: Render package owns a field-by-field deep copy of the entire Run_State and executes pp.step in the view layer
evidence:
shadow_clone :: proc(src: ^pp.Run_State, allocator := context.allocator) -> pp.Run_State {
	clone := src^ // scalars + rng + the struct shells (data pointers STALE)
[…]
		pp.step(&shadow, tt, batch[:], cat)
detail: The view layer now enumerates ~40 internal arrays across 8 core subsystems and runs the full sim pipeline. The assist.odin precedent cloned one subsystem and called a pure rebuild; this couples render to every future Run_State change.
recommended_fix: Move the predictor into core (e.g. growth_peek_next_spawn(state, cat, tick, pending, allocator) -> (pos, ok)); render keeps only the telegraph/reveal drawing. Same bit-exactness, layout knowledge stays beside the layout.

title: Missed-field guard for shadow_clone cannot catch never-serialized fields; a miss frees live sim memory
evidence:
clone := shadow_clone(&s, context.temp_allocator)
	defer pp.run_destroy(&clone)
	testing.expectf(t, sfx_hash(&clone, &cat) == sfx_hash(&s, &cat),
		"clone must hash-identical to the live state at clone time")
[… vs core/types.odin:299]
	cooldowns:   [dynamic]Cooldown_Entry, // 4.2 — recently-resolved root causes (the re-fire gate, arch §6.4); engine memory, never serialized
detail: A missed [dynamic] field stays aliased to live memory: hash equality holds by aliasing, and engine-memory fields (cooldowns, node_health, rings) are never hashed. run_destroy then frees live arrays; odin-test prints a non-gating 'bad free' (tests stay green).
recommended_fix: Add a durable aliasing probe: after shadow_clone, reflect-walk every Run_State field and assert no clone raw_data equals the source's. Catches any future missed field regardless of hash coverage.

title: spawn_fx_init/spawn_fx_destroy are never called; the reveals buffer self-allocates on the ambient allocator
detail: Grep shows no caller in app/ or harness/ (only feed/predict/reset). The reveals array therefore grows lazily via context.allocator — works (map_cells precedent) but the designed ownership/teardown path is dead API.
recommended_fix: Either wire spawn_fx_init/destroy into the app + harness View lifecycle, or delete them and document the lazy map_cells-style ownership at the append site.
